user.title: Create an aligned shade group
user.description: Group side-by-side shades so their bottom edges stay level.

pico.name: Pico remote (optional)
pico.description:
Paired Picos can start and stop grouped shades at the exact same time, keeping the hemlines level more precisely than sending each shade its own command.

To use this, pair a Lutron shade Pico (with a middle button) on the Caseta bridge with exactly these shades. Its On, Stop and Off buttons are disabled in Home Assistant by default, so enable them on the Pico's device page first.

data_description.device_id: Its On, Stop and Off buttons are found automatically.

data_description.name: For example, “Living Room Aligned”.
data_description.shades: The side-by-side shades to keep level. Each must support setting a position and stopping.

shade.title: {name} (shade {index} of {count})
shade.description: Where is this shade's bottom edge (hemline) when fully closed and when fully open? Measure every shade from the same point, such as inches from the floor.

travel.title: Travel time
travel.description:
How long does {name}, the tallest shade, take to go from fully closed to fully open? All shades in the group are assumed to move at the same speed.

Roller shades also don't move evenly: the roll is fattest when open, so the hemline drops faster near the top. If your shades' hemlines don't line up partway, set {name} to 50% on its own and enter its hemline height. This assumes the shades' rolls match: same fabric and tube, with the same amount of fabric wound on whenever their hemlines are level.

data_description.travel_time_s: If you're unsure, round down rather than up.
data_description.halfway_height: For {name}, between {low} and {high}. Leave empty if the shades line up partway already.

error.closed_not_below_open: The closed height must be below the open height.
error.cover_unsupported: Every shade must support setting a position and stopping.
error.ranges_do_not_overlap: This shade's open-to-closed range doesn't overlap the other shades'. Every shade's range must share some height.
error.halfway_out_of_range: That's outside the heights a roller shade can have at 50%; check the measurement and the open and closed heights.
error.halfway_cant_reach: This 50% height can't fit every shade on one roll curve, so your shades' rolls probably don't match. Leave it empty to align them as if every shade moved in a straight line, or check the measurements.
error.pico_not_a_shade_pico: That device doesn't have On, Stop and Off buttons. Choose a shade Pico with a middle button.
error.pico_buttons_disabled: Enable the Pico's On, Stop and Off buttons on its device page first (Home Assistant disables them by default).
